about: Curated stops for the New Jersey legs and their links to Wilmington and Baltimore (missing roads brief 1, 2026-11-22), placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. lat, lon, reach_mi, season and heading steer placement; every other key is the stop as the game reads it. A stop with a heading lands on a leg stored the other way with directions reverse.

truck_access.about: Read: OpenStreetMap truck parking at the service area, FHWA's Jason's Law inventory, or the operator's page. Assumed: Turnpike service areas with no truck parking mapped, on a road that carries tractor-trailers its whole length.
